description: Implementation of ProductReviewDao for accessing product review data, including methods for retrieving reviews by customer, product, product and customer, and with language filtering.

classes.name: ProductReviewDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for product reviews, providing methods to fetch reviews based on customer, product, and language.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews made by a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a review for a specific product by a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a product filtered by language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product review by its unique ID.
